props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Ids expanded on first render. Overrides `defaultDepth`.

props.name: defaultDepth
props.description: Without `defaultExpanded`, levels open on first render: 1 shows the top person’s reports.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected person’s id. Omit to let the chart track selection itself.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a card is clicked or activated with Enter or Space.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the viewport in pixels.

props.name: wheelZoom
props.description: Zoom with the mouse wheel. Off by default so the page still scrolls past the chart.
